name: termweave
description: A config-driven Tauri and OpenTUI builder for native desktop terminal apps.

scripts.lint: eslint src scripts shared tests vite.config.ts
scripts.tauri: bun run icons:generate && bun run config:sync && tauri
scripts.check: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run deps:check && bun run format:check
scripts.deps:install: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd sidecar --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd template --frozen-lockfile
scripts.deps:audit: bun scripts/packages/audit-packages.ts && cd src-tauri && cargo audit
scripts.app:format: bun run format && bun run --cwd sidecar format && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.app:check: bun run check && bun run --cwd sidecar check && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.app:dev: bun run app:check && bun run icons:generate && bun run config:sync && bun run sidecar:dev-launcher && tauri dev
scripts.app:build: bun run app:check && bun run icons:generate && bun run config:sync && bun run sidecar:build && bun scripts/app/build-app.ts
